en.headline: KMB adds overnight B10S route to Huanggang Port early Sunday
en.dek: The new service will run from Kwai Fong to the border from 00:40 to 02:00 on 1 November to handle post-Halloween passenger demand, with extra NB73 trips also arranged.
body: The Kowloon Motor Bus Company said it will introduce an additional overnight route B10S in the early hours of Sunday to strengthen services to Huanggang Port during the Halloween weekend.

The B10S will operate from 00:40 to 02:00 on 1 November, departing from the terminus beside MTR Kwai Fong Station and running to Huanggang Port. It will call at Tsing Yi Station and the Tai Lam Tunnel interchange. Passengers can connect from other overnight KMB routes at the interchange.

KMB said the route is intended to serve visitors returning to the mainland after late-night Halloween events across the city. It will also enhance the existing overnight route NB73 from Sha Tin Town Centre to Huanggang Port with special trips serving Sheung Shui Station and the San Tin transport interchange.

The Transport Department had earlier noted that northbound traffic and passenger flows at Huanggang Port are expected to be busy in the early hours over the weekend as multiple events conclude around midnight.

zh.headline: 九巴周日凌晨增設B10S深宵線往皇崗口岸
zh.dek: 新路線於11月1日凌晨0時40分至2時由葵芳開出，方便萬聖節活動後返回內地的乘客，同時加強NB73服務。
body: 九龍巴士公司宣布，將於星期日凌晨增設深宵路線B10S，加強萬聖節周末往皇崗口岸的巴士服務。
B10S於11月1日凌晨0時40分至2時運行，由港鐵葵芳站旁的總站開出前往皇崗口岸，途經青衣站及大欖隧道轉車站。乘客可利用其他九巴通宵路線到轉車站轉乘。
九巴表示，路線旨在方便市民及旅客在各區萬聖節活動結束後返回內地。同日亦會加強由沙田市中心往皇崗口岸的通宵路線NB73，增設特別班次往返上水站及新田運輸交匯處。
運輸署早前指出，周末多項活動在午夜前後結束，預料深宵時段皇崗口岸北行方向人流及車流將會繁忙。
